brand._source: Confirmed from the 2026 Umbrage Visual Style Guide. Palette = Savoy / Blush / Onyx + Bain Red. Type = Aptos family. Font-loading method (@font-face / files) still to confirm from the site repo at merge; for standalone dev, self-host Aptos (Aptos, Aptos Serif, Aptos Mono) or use a close fallback.

roles.ground: onyx.base #030511 — default dark ground for most of the page
roles.partnershipAccent: bainRed.6 #FF0025 for AA text on Onyx; bainRed.base for large accents only

editorial.use: sparingly — accents and large metric callouts only (e.g. the outcome stats)

utility.use: eyebrows, captions, data labels — uppercase, wide tracking

type.rules: Body 16–22px regular; bold reserved for headings and lead-in lines, never whole paragraphs. Eyebrows: mono, uppercase, spaced. Headings: Title Case. Buttons/labels: sentence case. (Keep headline COPY exactly as written in this file even where it reads sentence-case.)
type.loading: TBD — confirm Aptos web font files / @font-face from the site repo at merge.

surfaces: Onyx default — white type, Savoy & Blush accents
Off-white break — charcoal type, Savoy eyebrow (use once for contrast)
Partnership close — Bain Red 60 on Onyx (only if a partnership section is added)
brand.sectionMarker: Uppercase Aptos Mono eyebrow over a hairline rule. Left-justified: rule extends 80px past the text on the right. Centered: 80px on both sides. Savoy is default; Blush / Bain Red flag their own sections.

buttons.primary: no fill, solid on hover, no stroke
buttons.note: Not rendered on this page (see meta.renderCtas).

brand.colorRule: Flat color everywhere. The ONLY gradient in the system is the Praxis® wordmark (Blush into violet, clipped to the word) — not used on this page. Do NOT use gradients in backgrounds, cards, or the motion layer.
brand.mosaicGrid: Signature background motif: a gradient rendered as a grid of ≥8 equal-width columns, with Savoy + Blush glow coming through the Onyx base, tiling continuously between content areas. Glow shape adapts to context. Candidate background for the hero and challenge-cloud scenes.
brand.voice: Direct, confident, no hype. Lead with the outcome and the number. Short declaratives (“Built to ship.”). Avoid “unlock/empower/revolutionize”, ALL-CAPS, and emoji.
brand.logo: Full Umbrage wordmark + “Part of Bain & Company” at rest; reduces to the helmet mark on scroll. This is page chrome — not this standalone page's concern until merge.

offerings.name: AI Prequel
offerings.descriptor: The work that must be true before AI ships.
offerings.tagline: The work that must be true before AI ships.
offerings.valueStory: We find where AI can create real value, confirm your data and systems can carry it, and leave you with a roadmap you can actually build against.
offerings.outcome: A prioritized roadmap, and the confidence to know exactly where to invest first.

offerings.name: End-to-End AI Product Development
offerings.descriptor: Builds and ships a specific AI product.
offerings.tagline: Builds and ships a specific AI product.

offerings.name: Legacy Modernization

challenge.short: Your systems are holding you back
challenge.matrix: Your systems are holding you back

offerings.descriptor: The system that ships, governs, and hands over.
offerings.tagline: The system that ships, governs, and hands over.
offerings.valueStory: We standardize product strategy, engineering delivery, governance, and continuous improvement into one repeatable system, built through real product work — not a framework we hand you and leave.
